messages:
Ari: Quick sync — were getting a few support tickets where apps receive 429/503 when traffic is routed to slower hardware. Customers want a clearer programmatic hint so they can decide whether to retry or reduce concurrency.

Ari: Proposed change: enrich our error envelope with a short `client_action` enum and a `route_origin` tag. Keep HTTP codes unchanged. Example payload wed return:

```json
{
  "error": "CapacityFallback",
  "status": 429,
  "client_action": "reduce_batch_size",
  "retry_after_ms": 1200,
  "route_origin": "degraded_pool",
  "request_id": "r-abc123"
}
```

Ari: Console UX: show a compact badge on the route card  "degraded routing"  with tooltip: "Requests may be routed to lower-capacity hardware; expect higher latency or rate limits." Rollout behind feature flag.

Jasper: +1 on explicit `route_origin`. Suggest naming it `route_origin` (string) and `client_action` (enum). Actions: `retry`, `reduce_batch_size`, `split_requests`, `fallback_model`, `no_action`. Server routing matrix maps causes to actions.

Jasper: Mapping idea: primary-success -> no_action; primary-overload -> retry with `retry_after_ms`; fallback_due_to_capacity -> reduce_batch_size; hardware_degraded -> reduce_batch_size; region_failover -> fallback_model.

Leila: Telemetry: emit `route.origin` and `client_action` as span tags and log dimensions so dashboards can break down latency, error rate, and tenant impact by origin. Make tag values stable: degraded_pool, fallback_pool, primary, regional_failover.

Leila: Also add request-level metric `client_action_hint` so we can count how often each action appears. Alert rule suggestion: tenant error rate where >5% of requests have route.origin=degraded_pool for 5m.

Mike: SDKs: well add a typed enum mapping in the next minor release. For older SDKs well document the new fields as optional and ensure unknown fields are ignored so behavior doesn't break.

Mike: Streaming endpoints: include the hint as a single metadata/control frame before the token stream, and also in `X-Redwood-Client-Action` response header so non-streaming clients can read it.

Ari: Good. Also add `console_copy` with short localized text that the Console can display for the badge, e.g. "Routed to backup pool — consider reducing concurrency". Keep it short.

Jasper: Do NOT expose internal route_cost numbers in the client payload. Keep payload consumer-friendly and devoid of internal metrics.

Leila: Migration plan: feature flag `expose_client_action` with rollout pct. Telemetry instrumentation must be in place before enabling globally. Add unit tests validating unknown/new fields do not break older SDKs and that tags appear in traces.

Mike: Proposed rollout config snippet:

```yaml
feature_flags:
  expose_client_action:
    enabled: true
    rollout_pct: 20
    targets: [hosted, dedicated]
```

Mike: Also adding SDK tests and a note in changelog for app developers.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout job created: feature=expose_client_action, pct=20 -> 2026-04-01T02:00Z :white_check_mark:

Ari: Next steps: Ari opens runtime PR to add `route_origin` tag and enrich error envelope; Leila adds telemetry dims and dashboards; Mike preps SDK enum and header handling; Jasper drafts routing-to-action matrix doc. Target 2-week rollout after PR review.

Jasper: I'll draft the matrix and include examples of mapping failures -> client_action decisions.

Leila: I'll put the dashboard tile and the alert rule in our infra dashboard and verify tag cardinality in staging.

Mike: I'll add the header and streaming control frame tests. Will ensure older SDKs ignore unknown fields gracefully.

Ari: Thanks everyone. Small follow-up: keep client_action short (snake_case) and under 32 chars. Also ensure were not sending personally identifying info in `route_origin`.

Ari: Thanks :thumbsup:
